name: sdlc
description: One Claude Code plugin for the whole software lifecycle: an orchestrator sizes each piece of work (S/M/L) and walks it through four gated phases (define, build, prove, ship), from spec and design through TDD and one parallel round of a fresh verifier, multi-agent review and security checks to ship and learn, plus guardrail hooks, design-system-aware UI review and setup/upgrade for any stack or monorepo.
